limitations: This session produced NO fills, and what that demonstrates is narrow. It shows the paper session ran to completion, consumed captured market data, generated simulated orders, and recorded the risk layer's refusals. It is NOT evidence about profitability, and it is NOT evidence that fill handling, fee accounting, inventory behaviour, settlement or P&L are correct: with no fill, not one of those paths ever executed, which is why every such figure is null in `performance`. A desk that never traded has no P&L to be right or wrong about. Nothing here may be read as a return, an edge, a break-even result, or a validated strategy.
paper execution only — no order reached a venue
shadow fills are inferred from observed venue trades, not confirmed by one
queue position is estimated from published depth at the time of arrival
latency is an assumption, named by version, not a measurement
Incidents are AGGREGATED: 13160 were recorded and 200 ship verbatim as a sample. `incident_summary` carries the exact count per reason; no total has been rounded or truncated.
note: These are simulated orders. No order was submitted to any venue, and no money changed hands.
